rows.headline: The Exchange has sought clarification from Aeroflex Enterprises Ltd on October 13, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
rows.subject: Clarification sought from Aeroflex Enterprises Ltd
rows.title: The Exchange has sought clarification from Aeroflex Enterprises Ltd on October 13, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
Spurt in Volume
rows.summary: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Aeroflex Enterprises Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Aeroflex Enterprises Limited has submitted their response.
